en: The Comrade’s Long March. A documentary of efficiency, departure, and reunion.
the comrade backs the winning ticket. a quarter of a billion dollars is a small price for history. he jumps on stage in pennsylvania. the jump is recorded.
DOGE is proclaimed. two chairmen are appointed. one will leave on day one. the acronym is a dog. this is deliberate.
a special government employee. one hundred and thirty days permitted. the desk is in the executive office building. the son is in the oval office.
a chainsaw is raised at CPAC. an agency is fed into the wood chipper. every worker must report five bullet points. many bullet points are received.
the stock is down. the showrooms are picketed. the chairman purchases a red sedan on the south lawn. glorious support. the stock is still down.
twenty million dollars. a foam cheese hat. million-dollar cheques handed to voters. the people of wisconsin vote otherwise. the comrade learns of judicial independence.
one hundred and thirty days complete. a golden key is presented in the oval office. a black eye is presented by a five-year-old. the comrade returns to industry.
the comrade calls the big beautiful bill a disgusting abomination. the chairman calls for the contracts. posts are made. posts are deleted. regret is expressed within a week.
the bill passes on the fourth. a party is declared on the fifth. the party fields no candidates. the party is a post.
a handshake at a memorial in september. a dinner at mar-a-lago by winter. "lovely dinner." one hundred million dollars is pledged for the midterms. 2026 is going to be amazing.
the comrade now lives in an airstream trailer beside the works. the factories by day, the data center by night. "i am coming to you from the palace that i live in." the palace has wheels.
Post on X to make America strong, also known as the best country ever.
